wire_rule: integrator-approved shape: the version-13 NominalHeader representation byte (the last byte of the nominal row) gains 2 = Transparent beside 0 = Rust and 1 = C. It is read only under body_nodes() and only on struct headers; an enum header with byte 2 is rejected by the existing sum_contracts check. No layout or ABI fact travels: every consumer re-runs validate_repr and the transparent declaration check over its own facts. Known integrity limit: rewriting byte 2 to 0 relabels a transparent struct as repr(Rust); the representation byte is authenticated by the packet's inventory identity, not re-proved
